common.updateStale: New version already active — this tab still runs the old one. Save your work, then update.
common.tooLarge: “{{name}}” is {{size}} MB — the limit is {{max}} MB.
common.offline: Offline — entries are saved on this device
common.storageError: Saving failed — device storage is full. Changes now only live in this session. Free up space on the device.
common.storageUnreadable: Saved data could not be read. Nothing is being saved right now — please reload the app before entering anything.
common.storageAlmostFull: Device storage is almost full — back up and free up space soon.
common.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please finish or discard the open entry — you will be signed out afterwards.

crash.pageTitle: This view could not be displayed
crash.pageBody: The rest of the app keeps running. Go to the home screen or reload. If the error keeps coming back, choose “Back up data and start fresh” — the current data stays on this device as a backup.
crash.appBody: Please reload. If the error comes back, choose “Back up data and start fresh” — the current data stays on this device as a backup.
crash.reset: Back up data and start fresh
crash.resetFailed: The data could not be backed up — nothing was deleted.

login.subtitle: The internal communication app for instructors.
login.otpHint: You will receive a 6-digit sign-in code by email.
login.error: No account found for this email address. Accounts are created by an admin or superadmin.
login.noSignup: No self-registration — accounts are created by an admin or superadmin.
login.codeSentTo: We sent a 6-digit sign-in code to {{email}}.
login.codeError: Wrong or expired code. Request a new one if needed.
login.codeHint: The code and your session are valid until midnight — you stay signed in unless you sign out.
login.sandboxCode: Sandbox: your code is {{code}} — in production it arrives by email.

home.installHint: iPhone/iPad: add this app to your home screen to receive notifications.
home.installStep1: Open the app in Safari and tap the Share icon.
home.installStep3: Confirm with “Add” — the app then opens full-screen and can receive notifications.

chat.title: Chat
chat.noGroups: You are not a member of any group yet.
chat.noMessages: No messages yet — or they have already been auto-deleted.
chat.changeHint: One vote per person — changeable until the poll is closed.
chat.blockedNote: You have been blocked from sending in chat by an admin. You can still read messages. Please contact your administrator.
chat.notMemberNote: You are not a member of this group – you can read along; writing and voting are for members only.
chat.pollValidHint: Date and time are in UTC. After this time the poll closes automatically.
chat.deleteMessageConfirm: Delete this message for everyone? This cannot be undone.
chat.sendRejected: Not sent – your text is kept.
chat.sendRejectedBlocked: Not sent: you have been blocked from sending in chat. Your text is kept.
chat.sendRejectedNotMember: Not sent: you are not (or no longer) a member of this group. Your text is kept.
chat.sendRejectedTooLarge: Not sent: the attachment exceeds the limit (max. {{max}} MB). Remove it – your text is kept.
chat.pollRejected: Poll not created – please check the details.
chat.pollEndPast: This time is already in the past.
chat.pollEndAfterRetention: Too late: the group's retention deletes the poll on {{date}} at the latest.
chat.pollRetentionLimit: At the latest until {{date}} – then the group's retention ({{period}}) deletes the poll and its votes.
chat.groupNotCreated: Group not created – please check name and aircraft type.
chat.muteOnlyYou: Applies to you only, not to the other members.
chat.closePollConfirm: Close the poll now? Afterwards nobody can vote or change their vote.

chatInfo.title: Chat info
chatInfo.retentionNote: Messages in this group are automatically deleted after this period.
chatInfo.attachmentNote: Attachments are deleted together with their message.
chatInfo.deleteGroupHint: Removes the group with all messages, polls and attachments. Cannot be undone.
chatInfo.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” with all {{count}} messages? This cannot be undone.
chatInfo.deleteBlocked: Not possible: {{names}} would be left without any group. Add them to another group first.
chatInfo.removeBlocked: {{name}} would be left without any reachable group – add them to another group first.
chatInfo.membersRejected: Not changed – the member list was rejected.
chatInfo.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {{name}} from “{{group}}”? {{name}} will no longer be able to reach the group chat.

info.noMatch: No entry matches the search or filter.
info.permanentNote: Entries in this library are permanent — chat auto-deletion does not apply here.
info.ufnHint: Leave “Valid until” empty for UFN (until further notice).
info.confirmDelete: Delete this entry for all users?
info.requiresAck: Read confirmation required (each user must confirm)
info.scheduled: Scheduled — not yet visible to users
info.untilBeforeFrom: “Valid until” is before “Valid from” – the entry would never be visible.

notes.title: Title
notes.empty: No notes yet. Write down what you want to remember for the next session.
notes.deleteConfirm: Delete the note “{{title}}”? This cannot be undone.
notes.intro: Your personal notes — nobody else can see them, not even an admin. They are a memory aid, not a record: they are not attached to any form and are never part of an export.
notes.heading: Notes

contacts.name: Name
contacts.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” from the directory? This cannot be undone.
contacts.empty: The directory is empty. An admin can add contacts here.
contacts.phoneInvalid: This does not look like a phone number – use digits, spaces, + / - ( ) and at least 3 digits.
contacts.emailInvalid: This does not look like an email address (name@domain.com).

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Your feedback goes by email to the selected recipient.
feedback.identity: Sent with your name: feedback is not anonymous. {{name}} ({{email}}) will be visible to the recipients.
feedback.sentBody: Your feedback was sent and stored for the admins.
feedback.errorEmpty: Please fill in the marked required fields.
feedback.missingAircraft: Please choose the aircraft type – or “General”.

admin.title: Admin Panel
admin.maxUploadHint: Between 1 and {{max}} MB. Saved when you leave the field.
admin.fixedGeneral: “General” is the base category and always stays.
admin.fixedLastLesson: At least one training type stays.
admin.aircraftInUse: “{{typ}}” stays: still used by {{teile}}. Change it there first, then delete it here.
admin.confirmDeleteGroup: Delete this group including all messages?
admin.imprintHint: Formatting: “# ” starts a new section with a heading, “- ” a bullet line, blank lines separate paragraphs. Changes take effect immediately for all users.
admin.desktopOnly: The Admin Panel is available on desktop only — on tablets and phones the administration would be too cramped. Please open it on a computer.
admin.logbookHint: The same calculation as in “my AAA Logbook”: completed forms plus manual entries, including the instructors' corrections and deletions. The “Other Training” column also covers free-text categories.
admin.userGroupsHint: Everyone with chat must belong to at least one group they can enter. Groups control chat access and Instructor Info visibility; only groups of the selected types and cross-type groups are offered.
admin.emailLoginHint: The email address is the only sign-in credential — sign-in is by email only.
admin.permMatrixHint: The superadmin always has every permission. This matrix defines what Admin and Training Admin may do – including whether they grade and maintain the directory. What belongs to the individual person is listed below under “People”. Changes take effect immediately.

perm.grading_create: Fill in and send grading forms
perm.info_manage: Create and manage Instructor Info entries
perm.contacts_manage: Edit the Who to call directory

admin.lastGroupBlocked: Every user with chat needs at least one group they can enter – otherwise they lose access to chats and group-scoped Instructor Info. Assign a matching group first.
admin.aircraftTypesGlobal: Aircraft types (all forms and lesson plans)
admin.autoSaveHint: All changes in the Admin Panel are saved immediately — there is no save button.
admin.documentHeader: Print header of the training forms
admin.documentHeaderHint: Appears in the header and footer of every printed form and PDF.
admin.deactivateHint: Deactivated users keep their history and can no longer sign in. Records, messages and signatures stay attributable — that is why accounts are never deleted.
admin.emailTaken: This email address is already assigned to another user. It is the only sign-in identifier and has to stay unique.
admin.groupNameTaken: A group with this name already exists.
admin.noAccess: You do not have access to the Admin Panel.
admin.noUsersMatch: No user matches the current filters.
admin.storageHint: Data is stored on this device (IndexedDB). The bar shows how much of the browser-allotted space is in use; a warning banner appears app-wide above 85 %.
admin.storageUnknown: This browser does not report storage usage.

import.title: Import users from a table
import.intro: Download the template, fill it in with Excel, save it as “CSV UTF-8” and upload it here. You will see every row before anything is created. There are no passwords: people sign in with their email address and a 6-digit code, so the address decides — it must use an allowed domain.
import.headerError: The header row does not match. It must contain at least Name, Email and Role — use the template.
import.xlsxHint: This is an Excel file. Please save it in Excel via “Save As” as “CSV UTF-8” and upload that CSV file.
import.p_emailDomain: Domain not allowed — this person could never sign in
import.p_emailDuplicate: Email appears twice in the file
import.p_role: Role unknown (superadmin, admin, training admin, member)
import.templateHint: The same template as in Users → Import users. Fill it in with Excel, save it as “CSV UTF-8” and upload it under Users.
import.p_aircraftMissing: No aircraft type — this person would see no lesson plans, info entries or chats
import.groupsHint: Each new person joins the selected groups they can enter (matching aircraft type or cross-type). Anyone with chat who fits none of them is not created.
import.p_group: No selected group this person can enter

bulk.noChange: Nothing to change — the selection is already set that way
bulk.skippedSelf: Your own account was skipped — otherwise you would lock yourself out.
bulk.skippedLastSuper: The last active superadmin was skipped — otherwise nobody could reach the admin area.
bulk.roleNote: Role stays a single-user decision: a slip there would hit every selected account at once.
bulk.skippedHidden_one: {{count}} user was skipped — they were not in the list shown.
bulk.skippedHidden_other: {{count}} users were skipped — they were not in the list shown.
bulk.skippedLastAircraft_one: Not applied to {{count}} person: it would have been their last aircraft type. Their role would then see no lesson plans, no instructor info and no type-specific chats.
bulk.skippedLastAircraft_other: Not applied to {{count}} people: it would have been their last aircraft type. Those roles would then see no lesson plans, no instructor info and no type-specific chats.
bulk.skippedViaRole_one: Not applied to {{count}} person: for their role this permission is set by the role matrix, not per person.
bulk.skippedViaRole_other: Not applied to {{count}} people: for their role this permission is set by the role matrix, not per person.
bulk.skippedLastGroup_one: Not applied to {{count}} person: with that aircraft type they would have lost the last group they can enter.
bulk.skippedLastGroup_other: Not applied to {{count}} people: with that aircraft type they would have lost the last group they can enter.

admin.aircraftTypesHint: Controls which lesson plans, info entries and chats this person sees. At least one type.
admin.aircraftTypesFree: This role sees every type anyway. An assignment is possible but does not limit what they see.
admin.permPeopleHint: Trainee and chat block belong to the person for every role. Grading and directory editing are granted here for members only; for Admin and Training Admin the matrix above decides, and the superadmin may do everything anyway. Those cells read “via role” and show the effective value. Changes take effect immediately.
admin.permElsewhereHint: Two things are permissions as well, but they belong with their subject rather than here — listing them here too would mean maintaining them twice.
admin.permElsewhereUsers: Role and aircraft type assignment belong to a user’s identity.
admin.permElsewhereGroups: Who administers a chat is decided at that chat.
admin.docCheckHint: Who sees DocCheck and who maintains the master library. Only the superadmin grants these permissions; “DocCheck admin” requires “DocCheck access” and switches it on as well. The superadmin has DocCheck automatically. Every change is recorded in the DocCheck audit log.
admin.viaRoleHint: set by the role matrix for this role
admin.groupNameEmpty: A group name cannot be empty.
admin.groupSelfLocked: Only a superadmin can remove you from this group – otherwise you would lose it from your administration.
admin.groupNoAdminConfirm: “{{name}}” would no longer have an admin. Change anyway? Only the superadmin can then manage it.
admin.ownRoleLocked: Only another superadmin can change your own role.
admin.ownAccountLocked: Your own account – only another superadmin can deactivate it.
admin.roleConfirm: Change the role of {{name}} from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”? The permissions change immediately.

einzel.selbstRolle: Only another superadmin can change your own role – otherwise you could lock yourself out.
einzel.selbstDeaktivieren: Your own account cannot be deactivated – you would be locked out at once.
einzel.letzterSuperadmin: Not changed: {{name}} is the last active superadmin – otherwise nobody could reach the admin area.
einzel.letztesMuster: Not changed: {{name}} would have no aircraft type left and would see no lesson plans, no instructor info and no type-specific chats.
einzel.letzteGruppe: Not changed: {{name}} would lose the last group they can enter. Assign a matching group first.
einzel.gruppeFehlt: {{name}} is not yet in any group they can enter – please assign one.

admin.domainInvalid: Not a valid domain. Enter it without @, e.g. aviationacademy.at.
admin.domainLocksOutSelf: Not changed: with this list you could no longer sign in yourself.
admin.domainLocksOutSuper: Not changed: with this list no active superadmin could sign in – nobody could undo it.
admin.domainRemoveConfirm_one: Remove “{{domain}}”? {{count}} active account will no longer be able to sign in.
admin.domainRemoveConfirm_other: Remove “{{domain}}”? {{count}} active accounts will no longer be able to sign in.
admin.domainRemoveLast: Remove “{{domain}}”? The list will then be empty – which allows every domain.
admin.domainAddConfirm_one: Add this domain? {{count}} active account does not match the new list and will no longer be able to sign in.
admin.domainAddConfirm_other: Add this domain? {{count}} active accounts do not match the new list and will no longer be able to sign in.
admin.emailDomainNotAllowed: This domain is not allowed – the person could never sign in with this address. Allowed: {{list}}.
admin.userGroupsNotNeeded: No groups needed: this role has no chat.
admin.userGroupsNoneReachable: No group matches the selected aircraft types. Choose a type first – the person could not enter groups of another type.

lessons.title: Title
lessons.empty: No lesson plans available for your assigned aircraft types.
lessons.noAircraft: No aircraft type has been assigned to you yet. An admin can change this in user management — afterwards you will see the matching lesson plans.
lessons.deleteConfirm: Delete the lesson plan “{{title}}”? This cannot be undone.

toast.userSaveFailed: Not created — please check the entries.

logbook.title: my AAA Logbook
logbook.empty: No entries yet. As soon as a form is fully signed it appears here by itself — 308 as simulator training, 307 as ground training.
logbook.scopeHint: You only see entries in your aircraft types ({{muster}}) and those without a type.
logbook.scopeEmpty: {{name}} has no entries in your aircraft types ({{muster}}). Anything outside them is not visible to you.
logbook.timeMissingHint: The form states no session time. It only counts once it has been added.
logbook.durationInvalid: “{{text}}” is not a clear duration. Please enter it as 1:30 or 130.
logbook.derivedHint: This entry comes from a signed form. Only the logbook times are changed here — the form itself stays untouched.
logbook.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry of your own for good? This cannot be undone.
logbook.deleteConfirmForm: Remove this entry from the logbook? The form stays unchanged, and you can restore the entry below under “Removed form entries”.
logbook.removedHint: You removed these entries from the logbook; the forms themselves are unchanged. Once restored they count again with the times from the form.

docCheck.maintenanceBody: DocCheck has been switched off by the superadmin. All other areas of Instructor Connect are available as usual.
docCheck.errorBody: The error affects DocCheck only. All other tiles keep working.
docCheck.errorLoadBody: DocCheck is downloaded when first opened and after each update. Once a connection is back, “Try again” reloads the page. All other tiles keep working.
